reconstruction.scope: The square Visitors Centre retains its six-bay pale concrete frame, deep colonnades, recessed glazing, offset car-park entry, gridded roof and south terrace. The fitted deck exposes all four arcades and keeps the parking approach connected.

reconstruction.terrainBasis: The Visitors Centre floor and paved porticos share a fitted standard-Terrarium datum. The native hill, road and car park remain beyond the local footprint.
